items.title: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Good evaluations help teams ship AI agents more confidently. Without them, it’s easy to get stuck in reactive loops—catching issues only in production, where fixing one failure creates others. Evals make problems and behavioral changes visible before they affect users, and their value compounds over the lifecycle of an agent.

title_i18n.en: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
title_i18n.zh: 揭秘AI智能体评估
title_i18n.es: Desmitificando las evaluaciones para agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Good evaluations help teams ship AI agents more confidently. Without them, it’s easy to get stuck in reactive loops—catching issues only in production, where fixing one failure creates others. Evals make problems and behavioral changes visible before they affect users, and their value compounds over the lifecycle of an agent.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 良好的评估有助于团队更自信地部署AI智能体。缺乏评估则容易陷入被动循环——仅在投产阶段发现问题，而修复一个故障又引发其他问题。评估能揭示问题与行为。
excerpt_i18n.es: Las buenas evaluaciones ayudan a los equipos a lanzar agentes de IA con mayor confianza.
